assistiveTechnologyTests.procedure: Complete the journey and listen for the announcement or information under test.

title: Column headings are styled cells rather than header cells
description: The attendance table's first row is bold with a border, so it looks like a header row. The cells are td elements, so table navigation reports no column headers for the data cells below.

relatedElements.note: The control uses th scope=col for the same visible row.

expectedBehaviour: Visual column headings are marked up as column headers so data cells can be associated with them.
actualBehaviour: The heading row uses td elements with heading styling.
userImpact: Screen-reader users navigating by table cannot tell which column a value belongs to.

detection.note: The accessible roles differ (cell versus columnheader) even though the rendering is identical.

observed.note: Page-level axe run with tags wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa and best-practice. No violation was reported in the default state; the control on the same page or path also passes.

manualTests: Move through the attendance table in table navigation mode and listen for the column headings.

assertions: The alpha table has three td elements in thead and no th elements.
tests: tests/subtle-widgets.spec.js: keeps the alpha column headings as plain cells

reviewStatus.note: A Playwright regression test preserves the defective journey or widget behaviour and its control. That is automated reproduction, not a manual or assistive-technology observation.
